structured.answer: I didn't decide anything. Too many tracks, the companies all look alike and my bank isn't there. The only ones that looked safe were 'כספי (שקלי)' or 'אג"ח ממשלות' at about 4% (I'm not sure whether that's per year), so I'll ask my son and the bank before I open anything.
